no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not presented to an Advisory Committee. On January 15, 2003, the Endocrinologic and Metabolic Drugs Advisory Committee held a discussion of the application for Aldurazyme (laronidase), an exogenous enzyme therapy for Mucopolysaccharidosis Type I that was approved on April 30, 2003.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the Elaprase (idursulfase) BLA; the FDA Medical Review and Administrative Correspondence both state 'No AC.' The Division determined that the January 15, 2003 Endocrinologic and Metabolic Drugs Advisory Committee deliberations on the similar Aldurazyme (laronidase) application were generally applicable to Elaprase and that Elaprase raised no new issues requiring additional Advisory Committee input. Because no AdComm was held for this application, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
